attacks.claim: The record treats the installation of the specialised commercial courts as unknown (o4, grade D), has x2 tell the lawyer to check whether the court is installed, and says in k51 that the commercial section's former reach (b22) may still govern. The installation text exists: Executive Decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 creates twelve specialised commercial courts 'across the whole national territory' and gives each its area of judicial councils; the courts were installed from 23 January 2023 (tier-3 report, see below). For any petition drafted now, the Law 22-13 art. 13 condition is met everywhere, so the article 536 bis subjects have left the ordinary court; only cases filed before installation stay with the commercial section.

source.what: Executive Decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 fixing the territorial areas of the specialised commercial courts, JO no. 2 of 15 January 2023, pp. 18-19 (arts. 1-3 and annex: 12 courts, Béchar to Oran, covering every judicial council). Installation: Radio Algérie, 23 January 2023, https://news.radioalgerie.dz/ar/node/20519 (tier 3): «يشرف رؤساء المجالس القضائية عبر التراب الوطني, ابتداء من اليوم الاثنين, على تنصيب المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة».

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 2 : يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة باثنتي عشرة (12) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم. المادة 3 : تزود المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة للجزائر ووهران وقسنطينة بمقرات خاصة. تنعقد كل محكمة من المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة الأخرى بالمحكمة المحددة بموجب قرار من وزير العدل، حافظ الأختام، التابعة للمجلس القضائي الذي تقع في دائرة اختصاصه مقر المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة.
attacks.consequence: Settle o4 for current petitions: the specialised commercial courts are installed and cover the whole territory. x2 should send an article 536 bis dispute to another court (a question of subject-matter jurisdiction, art. 36), not tell the lawyer to check installation. The b22 reading ('before installation the commercial section keeps all commercial disputes') should apply only to cases already filed before installation (Law 22-13 art. 13 ¶2). The exit's message should name the prior conciliation of art. 536 bis 4, whose record of non-conciliation is required on pain of inadmissibility, even if the step itself belongs to another module.

attacks.claim: Territory rule t5 says only that the code's general and special territorial rules apply to the specialised commercial court (536 bis 1). That court's area is set by decree, as a list of judicial councils, and is not the ordinary court's area. Executive Decree 26-133 of 30 March 2026 replaced the annex: 25 courts, new areas, installed gradually, with the courts already installed covering the new areas until the new courts are installed, and pending cases staying put. A lawyer who follows t5 alone may file before the wrong specialised court, or before the specialised court of the old area.

source.what: Executive Decree 26-133 of 30 March 2026 amending and completing Executive Decree 23-53, JO no. 27 of 12 April 2026, pp. 10-11 (arts. 2, 2 bis, 2 bis 1, 2 bis 2 and the annex of 25 courts). The installation of the 13 new courts is reported by the Ministry of Justice through awras.com, 24 September 2026 (tier 3): «أعلنت وزارة العدل ... تنصيب 13 محكمة تجارية متخصصة جديدة، وذلك بمقرات المجالس القضائية».

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 2 : يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة بخمس وعشرين (25) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم. ... المادة 2 مكرر 1 : يمتد الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة المنصبة قبل صدور هذا المرسوم، إلى دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة الجديدة إلى حين تنصيب هذه الأخيرة. المادة 2 مكرر 2 : تبقى الإجراءات القائمة أمام المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة المختصة قبل صدور هذا المرسوم، من اختصاص نفس هذه الجهة القضائية دون تحويلها إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة الجديدة، المختصة إقليميا.
attacks.consequence: t5 should say that the code's territorial rules point to a place, and that the specialised commercial court competent for that place is the one whose annex lists its judicial council (Decree 23-53 as amended by Decree 26-133). Example: a company dispute whose seat is in Médéa now goes to the specialised commercial court of Blida (annex no. 6), not to a court in Médéa. The ledger and the store hold neither decree.

attacks.target: k3, k1, o6, k54, k15, o7, court_has_section_for_matter, x3
attacks.claim: k3 is answered 'searchedNotFound' and o6 says the list of sections is not in the texts. Organic Law 22-10 on judicial organisation, art. 21, lists the court's sections (civil, misdemeanours, contraventions, urgent matters, family, minors, social, real estate, maritime, commercial). It lets the court president reduce the number of sections or divide them into chambers by order. A court may therefore have merged sections by the president's order, which is neither 'section created' nor 'sections not created' in the sense of cpca 32 ¶5. So the slot court_has_section_for_matter and the reading of o7 rest on an incomplete picture. Art. 28 also allows specialised courts for commercial, real-estate and labour disputes to sit within a judicial council.

source.what: Organic Law 22-10 of 9 June 2022 on judicial organisation, JO no. 41 of 16 June 2022, p. 8, arts. 21, 23, 24 and 28.

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 21 : تشمل المحكمة الأقسام الآتية : – القسم المدني، – قسم الجنح، – قسم المخالفات، – القسم الاستعجالي، – قسم شؤون الأسرة، – قسم الأحداث، – القسم الاجتماعي، – القسم العقاري، – القسم البحري، – القسم التجاري. غير أنه، يمكن رئيس المحكمة، بعد استطلاع رأي وكيل الجمهورية، تقليص عدد الأقسام أو تقسيمها إلى فروع حسب أهمية وحجم النشاط القضائي. يفصل كل قسم في القضايا المعروضة عليه، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك. ... المادة 28 : يمكن أن يضم المجلس القضائي محاكم متخصصة تفصل في المنازعات ذات الطابع التجاري والعقاري والعمالي.
attacks.consequence: k3 becomes 'applies' (sections may be split into chambers by the president's order), and k1/o6/k54 cite art. 21 for the list of sections, including a maritime section and an urgent-matters section. The section question should allow for a court whose president has merged sections: the section to name is the one the president's order assigns, which the lawyer must check. o7 should take this text into account.

attacks.claim: n7 and o10 say the texts do not settle which court hears a civil servant's dispute, and ex18 still proposes the social section for a civil servant's reinstatement claim. Law 90-11 on labour relations, art. 3, takes civil servants, contract agents of public bodies and administrations of the State, wilayas and communes, and staff of public administrative establishments out of that law and puts them under special texts. Read with cpca 800, which the record cites, the employment-contract reading behind cpca 500 does not reach them. The record proposes the wrong section, and arguably the wrong court order, for a common case.

source.what: Law 90-11 of 21 April 1990 on labour relations, JO no. 17 of 25 April 1990, p. 562, art. 3 (also in the article store as labour-relations 3 ¶1, which the record does not cite).

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 3 : يخضع المستخدمون المدنيون والعسكريون التابعون للدفاع الوطني والقضاة والموظفون والأعوان المتعاقدون في الهيئات والإدارات العمومية في الدولة والولايات والبلديات ومستخدمو المؤسسات العمومية ذات الطابع الإداري، لأحكام تشريعية وتنظيمية خاصة.
attacks.consequence: When worker_is_public_servant is yes, the section rule should not propose the social section. It should cite labour-relations 3 with cpca 800 and route the case to the administrative-court exit, warning for a contract agent of a public industrial or commercial body, whom art. 3 does not name. ex18 should expect no social section.

attacks.claim: The social alternative and x3 fire only on the request kinds 'wages' and 'reinstatement'. Cpca 500 gives the social section exclusive jurisdiction over the termination of employment contracts, social-security and retirement disputes, and collective agreements, which the record quotes (b11, b12) but never uses in a rule. Case: a dismissed worker sues only for compensation for abusive dismissal (requests: damages), or an insured person contests a CNAS decision (requests: payment). The record proposes the civil section and gives no warning; n4 covers only a wage debt. In a court without sections it again proposes civil, where cpca 32 ¶5 excepts social cases.

source.what: Law 08-09 of 25 February 2008, Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure, JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 41, art. 500 (unchanged by Law 22-13 per the ledger).

attacks.quoteArabic: يختص القسم الاجتماعي اختصاصا مانعا في المواد الآتية : ... 2 - تنفيذ وتعليق وإنهاء عقود العمل والتكوين والتمهين، ... 6 - منازعات الضمان الاجتماعي والتقاعد، 7 - المنازعات المتعلقة بالاتفاقات والاتفاقيات الجماعية للعمل.
attacks.consequence: The social alternative and x3 should fire on the nature of the dispute, for example on a slot asking whether the claim arises from an employment, training or apprenticeship relationship, or is a social-security or retirement dispute, and not only on two request kinds. A damages or payment claim by a worker against an employer should not fall to the civil section by default.

attacks.target: court.section (realEstate alternative on partition), b18, ex8, o5
attacks.claim: The record sends every 'partition' request to the real-estate section, with no warning (ex8), on cpca 512 ¶10. The code puts estate claims (دعاوى التركة) in the family-section chapter (Book II, Title I, Chapter I, Section 7: arts. 498-499, where the family judge also orders the protective measures over the estate). Art. 40 ¶3 lists inheritance matters with divorce, custody and maintenance. Case: heirs ask for the partition of an estate that holds a flat and bank savings. The record proposes the real-estate section silently, and cites neither 498 nor 499. o5's 'why' mentions estates, but no reading, warning or slot follows from it.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 41, arts. 498 and 499, under «الفصل الأول في قسم شؤون الأسرة / القسم السابع في التركة».

attacks.quoteArabic: القسم السابع في التركة. المادة 498 : يؤول الاختصاص في دعاوى التركة إلى المحكمة التي يقع فيها موطن المتوفى، حتى وإن وجدت بعض أملاك التركة خارج دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي لهذه المحكمة، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك. المادة 499 : يجوز لقاضي شؤون الأسرة، وعن طريق الاستعجال، أن يتخذ جميع التدابير التحفظية، لاسيما الأمر بوضع الأختام، أو تعيين حارس قضائي لإدارة أموال المتوفى إلى غاية تصفية التركة.
attacks.consequence: Ask whether a partition is the partition of an estate. If it is, warn that the family-section chapter (498-499) and the real-estate section (512 ¶10) compete. Add an estate-partition example. Also note in t3/t4 that art. 498 sends estate claims to the court of the deceased's domicile, not the court where the property lies.

attacks.claim: The family alternative fires only on the request kinds divorce, tatliq, khul, maintenance, custody, custody_transfer, visitation, housing and guardianship. The family-section chapter also covers disputes over the dowry and over the furnishings of the marital home (cpca 426 ¶7 and ¶9), proof of marriage and filiation, and kafala (cpca 423 ¶4-5, quoted in b9 but used by no rule). Case: a divorced wife sues for her unpaid deferred dowry (requests: payment), or for the return of her household goods (متاع بيت الزوجية). The record proposes the civil section and gives no warning.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 36, art. 423 ¶4-5 and art. 426 ¶7 and ¶9, in the family-section chapter.

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 426 : تكون المحكمة مختصة إقليميا : ... 6 - في موضوع متاع بيت الزوجية بمكان وجود المسكن الزوجي، ... 8 - في موضوع المنازعة حول الصداق بمكان موطن المدعى عليه، ... المادة 423 : ... 3 - دعاوى إثبات الزواج والنسب، 4 - الدعاوى المتعلقة بالكفالة،
attacks.consequence: The family alternative should not depend only on those request kinds. It should also fire when the dispute is between spouses or former spouses, or concerns dowry, household goods, proof of marriage or filiation, or kafala, for example through a 'family relationship' slot. t4 should add the territorial rules of 426 ¶7 and ¶9.

attacks.target: court.section (commercial_lease alternative), n3, o2, ex5, ex15
attacks.claim: For every commercial lease the record proposes the commercial section, and n3/o2 weigh only the commercial section against the real-estate section. The Commercial Code sends one common commercial-lease dispute to neither: where the landlord agrees to renew but the parties disagree on rent, duration or terms, they must appear before the president of the court where the building lies, under the summary procedure, whatever the rent. This holds for leases governed by the pre-2005 regime (art. 187 bis 1 keeps renewal of leases concluded before Law 05-02 under the old rules). For such a dispute the record names the wrong judge and the wrong procedure.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), art. 195 ¶1 and ¶5, and art. 187 bis 1 (Law 05-02), read in the project article store (commercial-code 195, 187 مكرر 1); the Official Journal page (JO no. 101 of 1975) was not opened, so this is a lead to be checked there, including for later amendments of art. 195.

attacks.quoteArabic: اذا وافق المؤجر على تجديد الايجار وكان أمر الخلاف يتعلق ببدل الايجار أو المدة أو الشروط اللاحقة أو بمجموع هذه العناصر، وجب على الطرفين الحضور أمام رئيس المحكمة المختصة، التي يكون موقع العمارة تابعا لها ، وذلك مهما كان مبلغ الايجار والذي يقوم بالبت فيها حسب الاجراء المقرر في قضايا الامور المستعجلة. ... يفصل رئيس المحكمة في الدعوى بموجب أمر مسبب.
attacks.consequence: n3, or a new boundary, should flag the renewal-terms dispute of a commercial lease concluded before Law 05-02 (or with a contractual right of renewal) as belonging to the court president under the summary procedure, outside the section rule.

attacks.claim: The commercial-lease alternative proposes the commercial section as the answer, citing b21, b19 and b48. Rule n3 on the same fact says the texts do not settle the section. Also, b19 gives leases of dwellings and professional premises to the real-estate section, and b48 only fixes the territorial court. A proposal on this fact is stated more firmly than its own texts allow, and it precedes the real-estate alternative.
attacks.evidenceWords: ينظر القسم العقاري على الخصوص في القضايا الآتية : / 10 - في إيجار السكنات والمحلات المهنية / ترفع الدعاوى أمام الجهات القضائية المبينة أدناه دون سواها

attacks.claim: The alternative 'court_has_section_for_matter is no' gives civil with basis b4 for every matter. b4 excludes social cases from the civil section, so wages or reinstatement in a court without sections would be sent to civil if this alternative wins over the social one. Rule x3 says the opposite, that no section is named. The precedence between the alternatives is not stated.
attacks.evidenceWords: يبقى القسم المدني هو الذي ينظر في جميع النزاعات باستثناء القضايا الاجتماعية

attacks.claim: The request kind 'housing' is mapped to the family section with basis b7, b8 and b10, and none of these three paragraphs mentions housing. Housing could instead mean a dwelling lease, which b19 gives to the real-estate section. The family alternative precedes the real-estate one, so the lease reading is shadowed.
attacks.evidenceWords: دعاوى النفقة والحضانة وحق الزيارة، / في إيجار السكنات والمحلات المهنية

attacks.claim: The slot public_body_party and the rule's condition list the State, a wilaya, a commune and a public administrative body only. Art. 800 also covers national public bodies and national professional organisations, so a case with one of those as a party does not trigger the warning. The warning text itself names them, but the slot question cannot capture them.
attacks.evidenceWords: أو الهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية طرفا فيها

attacks.claim: The rule only warns. Art. 800 attributes these cases to the administrative courts ('تختص'), subject to the exceptions in 800 ¶1 and 802. Subject-matter jurisdiction is public order that the court raises of its own motion (b28), so a warning understates the effect. The basis also cites b2, which does not bear on this.
attacks.evidenceWords: تختص المحاكم الإدارية بالفصل في أول درجة / عدم الاختصاص النوعي من النظام العام، تقضي به الجهة القضائية تلقائيا

attacks.claim: n4 says a wage debt before the civil section is actually for the social section, with no condition. n7 says that for a civil servant the texts do not settle the court. n4 fires on a public servant's wage claim and gives a firm answer against n7's open one. n4 also ignores the employer in bankruptcy slot, where b23 points to the specialised commercial court.
attacks.evidenceWords: يختص القسم الاجتماعي اختصاصا مانعا في المواد الآتية : / التسوية القضائية والإفلاس

attacks.claim: t4 says the marital-home court hears divorce, but b42 makes the rule different for divorce by mutual consent, where the court is that of either spouse's residence at their choice. This exception is dropped, so the territory shown for a consent divorce is wrong.
attacks.evidenceWords: وفي الطلاق بالتراضي بمكان إقامة أحد الزوجين حسب اختيارهما

attacks.claim: t1 fires only when work_accident_or_occupational_illness is 'no', and t2 only when it is 'yes'. When the answer is unknown, no territorial rule shows, although the lawyer needs to know that the domicile of the plaintiff may apply (501 ¶2, 40 ¶10).
attacks.evidenceWords: غير أنه في حالة إنهاء أو تعليق عقد العمل بسبب حادث عمل أو مرض مهني، يؤول الاختصاص إلى المحكمة التي يوجد بها موطن المدعي

attacks.claim: t5 names no concrete territorial court for the commercial section or the specialised commercial court and only refers to the code. The civil section, the default of the module, has no territory entry at all. A claim before the civil section therefore gets no territorial guidance.
attacks.evidenceWords: تطبق على القسم التجاري، أحكام الاختصاص الإقليمي المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون والقواعد الواردة في القانون التجاري والقانون البحري والنصوص الخاصة

attacks.claim: n1 says a wrongly listed case is not a lack of subject-matter jurisdiction ending the claim. Art. 32 ¶6 only provides for a referral through the registry after the president is told. It does not say the matter is not a jurisdiction defect, and the item cites b28 (public order, raised of the court's own motion), which cuts against its conclusion.
attacks.evidenceWords: يحال الملف إلى القسم المعني عن طريق أمانة الضبط، بعد إخبار رئيس المحكمة مسبقا / عدم الاختصاص النوعي من النظام العام

attacks.claim: The item says the repealed paragraphs concern the specialised poles. The repealing text names only the numbers 7 to 10 of art. 32 (and arts. 826, 835, 836, 912, 913 and 914), and does not say what they are about. The item also leaves out the other articles repealed. b6, which says the court may have poles, still sits next to it without any note of conflict.
attacks.evidenceWords: الفقرات 7 و 8 و 9 و 10 من المادّة 32 والمواد 826 و835 و836 و912 و913 و914

attacks.claim: x2 warns that the commercial section's competence depends on the installation of the specialised commercial court, but the section choice dispute_is_commercial gives commercial with no check on this. Basis b25 (pending cases kept by the commercial sections) is cited for a rule it does not support: it concerns cases filed before installation, not the choice of section for a new case.
attacks.evidenceWords: وتبقى الجهات القضائية الإدارية والأقسام التجارية مختصة بالفصل في الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامها قبل تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة

attacks.claim: No rule handles a wage or dismissal claim against an employer in bankruptcy or judicial settlement (slot employer_in_bankruptcy_or_settlement exists but is unused here), which b23 gives to the specialised commercial court. The slots requests, dispute_is_commercial, dispute_concerns_real_property, court_has_section_for_matter and specialised_commercial_subject are also not in the declared slot list.

From memory: disputes of civil servants are governed by the public service statute (Ordonnance 06-03 of 15 July 2006) and by CPCA art. 801. Look for whether these send such disputes to the administrative courts or leave some, for example contractual agents, to the social section.

From memory: a decree or order installing the specialised commercial courts (after law 22-13 of 12 July 2022) may fix the date or the list of courts. Look for the installation text, since b24 and x2 leave the date open.

In family matters: divorce and return to the marital home go to the court of the marital home, custody and visitation to where custody is exercised, maintenance to the creditor's domicile. | no: The statement includes divorce without distinguishing the expressly different venue for divorce by mutual consent: «وفي الطلاق بالتراضي بمكان إقامة أحد الزوجين حسب اختيارهما».

When specialised commercial subject is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (specialisedCommercialCourt). | no: The rules apply «ابتداء من تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة», and earlier cases remain with the existing bodies: «وتبقى الجهات القضائية الإدارية والأقسام التجارية مختصة بالفصل في الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامها قبل تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة».

The civil section of the court hears this claim. | partly: The text does not identify this claim's nature or establish that it belongs to the civil section. The express residual rule applies where sections have not been created and excludes social cases.

When public body party is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt). | no: The rule has express exceptions: «باستثناء المنازعات الموكلة إلى جهات قضائية أخرى». Article 802 states «يكون من اختصاص المحاكم العادية المنازعات الآتية», including «مخالفات الطرق» and the specified public-vehicle damage claims.

By way of exception to the administrative courts, the ordinary courts hear road offences and liability claims for damage caused by a vehicle of the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body. | partly: The ordinary courts' jurisdiction is stated, but the excerpt does not identify articles 800 and 801 as administrative-court jurisdiction rules.

The paragraphs on the specialised poles were repealed from the CPCA article on the court's make-up. | partly: The text repeals paragraphs 7–10 of article 32, but does not say that those paragraphs concern specialised poles or identify article 32 as concerning the court's make-up.
The court may also be made up of specialised poles. | partly: The possibility of forming specialised poles is stated, but this excerpt does not identify the subject of «تتشكل» as the court.

Additional requests that follow from the main request are admitted before the social section at every stage, even if they were not put to conciliation. | partly: The rule for additional requests is stated, but the excerpt does not say that it applies before the social section.

Urgent matters and requests for protective measures are brought by petition before the court where the problem or measure arises. | partly: For protective measures, the text specifies «غير منظم بإجراءات خاصة». It does not establish the same petition and venue rule for protective measures governed by special procedures.

When (the petition asks for wages or the petition asks for reinstatement) and court has section for matter is no, the case leaves the ordinary courts (otherSection). | partly: The text does not identify wage or reinstatement claims, equate absence of the relevant section with absence of sections generally, or say that such cases leave the ordinary courts for 'otherSection'.

In a social dispute the territorial court is that of the place where the employment contract was made or performed, or of the defendant's domicile. | partly: The territorial connecting factors are stated, but the excerpt does not establish that this rule governs social disputes generally.

The commercial section hears commercial disputes, except those given to the specialised commercial court. | partly: The excerpt excludes disputes mentioned in article 536 مكرر, but does not say that those disputes are assigned to the specialised commercial court.

In its former wording, the article gave the commercial section commercial disputes and, where relevant, maritime disputes. | partly: The jurisdiction described is stated, but the excerpt does not say that this is the article's former wording.
